name: ERP Backup Settings
description: Configuration for the ERP Monthly Backup module: schedule, retention, storage backend, notification recipients, and the list of business DocTypes included in the human-readable CSV export. Ships DISABLED - a System Manager must tick 'Enable Scheduled Backups' to start the monthly schedule.

fields.label: Enable Scheduled Backups
fields.description: Off by default. When on, a backup runs automatically on the configured day/hour each month.

fields.label: Frequency
fields.description: V1 supports Monthly. The hourly scheduler only fires on the matching day + hour below.

fields.label: Hour (0-23)
fields.description: Local server hour to run at. Default 02:00, off-peak.

fields.label: Keep N Monthly Backups
fields.description: Newest N monthly backups are kept; older ones are pruned (archive deleted + record removed).

fields.label: Year-End Month
fields.description: A scheduled backup in this month is tagged 'Year-End' and (if the box above is ticked) never pruned. A backup marked 'Keep Forever' is also always preserved.

fields.label: Storage Backend
fields.description: V1 stores locally. The code has a storage abstraction so S3 / GCS / Azure can be added later without touching the backup logic.

fields.label: Local Storage Path
fields.description: Absolute directory for archives. Leave blank to use the site's PRIVATE backups area (recommended - never web-served): <site>/private/backups/erp_monthly.

fields.label: Notification Recipients
fields.description: Email addresses (comma or newline separated) to notify on success/failure. Blank = all enabled System Managers.

fields.options: DocTypes exported to CSV for data portability (recovery Layer 2). Child tables are listed separately - each retains its parent reference via the parent/parenttype/parentfield columns. This list never affects the authoritative database dump.
